about.role: Full Stack Developer · Data Science · Cybersecurity
about.bio1: Originally from Ivory Coast, I am currently a Master's student in Computer Systems Engineering, specializing in Data Science & Information Systems at SUP MTI Beni Mellal, Morocco. My journey led me to develop dual technical expertise: Full Stack development on one side, Data Science and Cybersecurity on the other.
about.bio2: During my internship at US2i (Beni Mellal), I worked on system maintenance, project coordination, and application development using Laravel and React. My goal is to join an international team after graduation.

story.title: My story
story.p1: It all started with a passion for problem-solving. From my very first lines of code, I understood that computer science is much more than a technical discipline — it's a tool to turn ideas into concrete realities.
story.p2: After my Baccalaureate in Ivory Coast, I continued my studies in Morocco at SUP MTI, where I earned my Bachelor's degree before joining the Master's program. This experience shaped me technically and taught me to work in multicultural environments.
story.p3: Today, I'm building this portfolio with a clear goal: land an international opportunity and contribute to projects that truly matter.

value.curiosity.desc: I learn constantly — every problem is an opportunity.
value.rigor.desc: Clean code, solid architecture, reliable results.
value.collab.desc: The best projects come from great teamwork.
value.ambition.desc: Aiming for the international stage, always going further.
